model.line: The walled compound as the plan S01 draws it, on the terrace the dig shows, with every hall drawn by the hall kit from its numbers and adapted to what the texts and the ruin say: 含经堂 seven bays, double-eaved, glazed (S940, S361); 淳化轩 seven by three bays on its terrace (S940, P0404); 蕴真斋 with its porches (S940, S01). No picture of any hall standing survives: every elevation is the kit's (C); the halls of the side courts are their class's (assumed).
rows: Layout
The walled compound and its forecourt as the plan S01 draws them (re-read in Round 17, B), checked against the Yangshi Lei plans 长春园淳化轩 as S940 prints them (figs. 5, 6)
Forecourt
Walls on three sides with the three glazed archways 琉璃坊楔 (S05; their form the class's, C), crossing stone paths and four lawns where the yurts stood (S940 p.360)
Terrace

The compound stands 2.1 m above the forecourt: measured on the ruin photographs P0403, P0505, P0815 (C); the curved edge from S01; the gate's projection 13.5 m wide with three flights as the ruin shows it (S01 draws 24 m, Q244)
Gate 宫门
Five bays (S05 '宫門五楹南嚮'), at its box on S01; doors, bracket band and roof from the hall kit (C)
含经堂

Seven bays and a porch all round (S05; S940 p.360; S01's nine cells), double-eaved 歇山 (S940, S361), yellow glazed (glazed: S361; the colour C, Q143); a front terrace of 0.8 m with a 4.3 m flight before a 1.5 m platform (P0402, C)
Court of 含经堂
The screen wall 影壁 on the axis (S01, S940; its 0.4 m base from P0402), side halls east and west (S940), the two-storey ⊐ ranges 梵香楼 (west) and 霞翥楼 (east) on S01's plan (storeys from the names, C)
Galleries and rockery
The galleries 墨刻游廊 with the 淳化阁帖 stones set in their outer walls (S05 j83:4b; S940 p.361); the rockery between 含经堂 and 淳化轩 (S01, S940; its rocks placed C); plum trees in the court (E0068; places C)
淳化轩
Seven by three bays (S940 p.360), rolled 歇山, glazed (S940 pp.360-361; colour C, Q151); its terrace 17 x 5.5 m with two flights 2.5-3 m in from its ends (S01; P0404)
蕴真斋
Seven bays with porches front and back (S940 p.360; S01's cross), its front arm a terrace; rolled grey 歇山 (C)
Side courts

Every hall inside the wall at its box, drawn from its class by the hall kit (assumed); 三友轩 at its measured 11.1 x 7.2 m on 11.9 x 8.3 m (S940 p.364) with pine, bamboo and plum (S940); 渊映斋 five bays and the dressing room's platform from P0410; the stage 乐奏钧天 as a two-storey pavilion (C)
Assumed

Every elevation (no picture of any hall standing survives), the halls of the side courts, the archways' faces, the north gate, the flights on the curves: from the hall kit's classes and the Qing manual's typology (C, the pale tint with conf=1)

evidence.title: 御製 三友軒
evidence.excerpt_zh:
三友軒
禁中三友軒額為（去聲）藏名蹟園中三友軒窓外真培植名實雖不同要以取有益寓意非玩物向曽詠其徳（舊題）（三友軒詩以松喻直梅喻諒竹喻多聞並就其徳性推言之）益常願居前損則應離側三者正相反求友可不擇於恒總宜謹況在躬為辟
evidence.summary: He separates the 三友軒 in the palace, named for paintings it holds, from the one in the garden, named for the pine, plum and bamboo planted outside its window.

evidence.title: 三友轩
evidence.locator: v3 p.254, under 含经堂; source ref 10-736
evidence.excerpt_zh: 禁中三友轩，额为藏名迹。园中三友轩，窗外真培植。名实虽不同，要以取有益。寓意非玩物，向曾咏其德
evidence.summary: Poem 三友轩 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1770, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

evidence.title: 三友轩歌
evidence.locator: v3 p.284, under 含经堂; source ref 2-90
evidence.excerpt_zh: 松高荫翠招长风，飒然拂竹摇玲珑。迎冬梅蕊机已动，素心相印形神通。品尊卉木推三友，浮筠劲节岁寒守。肯因冰雪易贞坚，夭桃秾李皆厮走。
evidence.summary: Poem 三友轩歌 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1801, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

evidence.title: 题三友轩
evidence.locator: v3 p.296, under 含经堂; source ref 4-180
evidence.excerpt_zh: 严飙卷冻云，暖旭映朱牗。蜃窗朗西轩，坐对三益友。苍颜欣不凋，夭矫岁寒后。筼筜枝茂蕃，碧筠劲节守。梅占百花先，冷艳屏尘垢。神契物外交，忘年乐悠久。
evidence.summary: Poem 题三友轩 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1809, filed by the editors under 含经堂.

evidence.title: 紫禁城宁寿宫区与长春园含经堂区建筑关系探讨 (王文涛, 故宫学刊 2015): the 含经堂 layout from the dig
evidence.summary: From the dig and the archives: the compound is about 300 m north-south by 200 m east-west. Forecourt with three glazed pailou (east, south, west) and four lawns where yurts stood; five-bay gate with a 垂花门 each side; 含经堂 a seven-bay double-eaved hip-and-gable hall with side halls and the towers 霞翥楼 and 梵香楼; 淳化轩 seven by three bays, the largest single building of Changchun Yuan, hip-and-gable (rolled ridge on p.360, glazed on p.361); 蕴真斋 seven bays with front and back porches; 渊映斋 and 涵光室 five-bay hip-and-gable; 三友轩 three bays, measured about 11.1 x 7.2 m on a platform 11.9 x 8.3 m; 静莲斋 five bays; 理心楼 five bays; 待月楼 a three-bay two-storey hip-and-gable tower facing east; 澄波夕照 and 得胜概 three-bay open halls; a two-storey stage 乐奏钧天 with a five-bay viewing hall 神心妙达 rebuilt in mid-Jiaqing. Floor heating survives in five halls. The remains are Qianlong work with some of the 1814 rebuilding, nothing later. 淳化轩 was the model for 乐寿堂 in the 宁寿宫.

evidence.title: 嘉庆帝所题圆明园淳化轩诗考析 (尤李)
evidence.summary: Through Jiaqing's poems. It dates the addition of 淳化轩, 蕴真斋, 三友轩, 静莲斋, 待月楼 and 理心楼 behind 含经堂 to 1770, when the compound reached full size. The 重刻淳化阁帖 stones were set in the galleries in front of 淳化轩.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 含经堂
evidence.summary: The largest group in this garden, finished 1747, rebuilt 1770 with 淳化轩, 蕴真斋, 三友轩, 静莲斋, 待月楼 and 理心楼. 含经堂 is a seven-bay double-eaved glazed hall; 霞翥楼 mirrors 梵香楼 and, with the inner plaque 味腴书室, held the 四库全书荟要, which identifies our 味腴书屋. A stage was added east of 淳化轩 in 1814. Guards were still posted after 1860.

evidence.title: 圆明园长春园含经堂遗址发掘报告: table of contents
evidence.locator: 目录, 第三章 遗迹
evidence.summary: The full report of the 2001-2003 seasons lists every excavated unit: in the south the three-arch pailou, walls, paths, carved-brick paving and yurt (毡帐) foundations and tree pits in the forecourt, the gate, the 含经堂 court with screen gate, main hall, east and west side halls, 霞翥楼, 梵香楼, galleries and a 垂花门; in the north 淳化轩 with a Taihu rockery before its terrace, 蕴真斋, the north gate and the open hall 得胜概; east 渊映斋, the dressing room and 乐奏钧天 stage, the viewing hall 神心妙达 and the shop street outside; west 涵光室, 三友轩 with its rockery, 静莲斋, 理心楼, 待月楼 and the open hall 澄波夕照 outside; round about duty rooms, stores, a well pavilion, a timber bridge, 明漪潇照, 云容水态 and the octagonal 静缘亭.

evidence.title: 紫禁城宁寿宫区与长春园含经堂区建筑关系探讨 (王文涛, 故宫学刊 2015)
evidence.summary: Compares the Ningshou Gong in the Forbidden City with the Hanjing Tang compound, which Qianlong built in phases from 1745 to 1771 for his retirement. It lists each hall's bays and roof, measures 三友轩 on the ruin, and describes some twenty underfloor heating systems found in the 2001-03 dig, with flue sizes. Figures include Yangshi Lei sheets of 淳化轩 (Qianlong and Jiaqing) at the NLC and the late plan from 金勋's collection.
